title: Scheduling Order, Notice of Technical Conference, and Notice of Hearing (Docket No. 26-057-03)
text:
- BEFORE THE PUBLIC SERVICE COMMISSION OF UTAH - 

Application of Enbridge Gas Utah for 
Approval of Wexpro Horizontal Drilling 
Pilot Program 

DOCKET NO. 26-057-03 

SCHEDULING ORDER, NOTICE OF 
TECHNICAL CONFERENCE, AND 
NOTICE OF HEARING 

ISSUED: March 9, 2026 

At the scheduling conference the Public Service Commission (PSC) held on 
March 6, 2026, the parties in attendance stipulated to the following schedule, which 
the PSC approves and adopts: 
SCHEDULE 
ITEM 
DEADLINE/DATE/TIME/LOCATION 
Technical conference 
Tuesday, March 24, 2026, beginning at 10:00 
a.m., Fourth Floor Room 401, Heber M. Wells 
Building, 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, 
Utah. Any person who wishes to submit 
questions in advance of the technical 
conference should send them via email to all 
of the following: the PSC (psc@utah.gov); 
Jenniffer Clark 
(jenniffer.clark@enbridge.com); and Austin 
Summers (austin.summers@enbridge.com) 
before 5:00 p.m. on Tuesday, March 17, 2026. 
Direct testimony, non-applicant 
parties 
Friday, April 3, 2026 
Intervention deadline 
Monday, April 6, 2026 
Rebuttal testimony, all parties 
Friday, April 10, 2026 
DOCKET NO. 26-057-03 

- 2 - 

Hearing 
Thursday, April 23, 2026, beginning at 9:00 
a.m., Fourth Floor Hearing Room 403, Heber 
M. Wells Building, 160 East 300 South, Salt 
Lake City, Utah 

DISCOVERY 

Discovery turn-around times shall be best efforts. Parties shall serve discovery 
requests and responses on applicable parties by electronic mail. In the event a 
document produced in response to a discovery request cannot reasonably be 
transmitted by electronic mail, the party disclosing the document shall provide an 
electronic copy of the document on CD (or, if an electronic copy is not available, a 
paper copy). 
NOTICE OF TECHNICAL CONFERENCE 

A technical conference will be held in this docket on Tuesday, March 24, 2026, 
beginning at 10:00 a.m., Fourth Floor Room 401, Heber M. Wells Building, 160 East 300 
South, Salt Lake City, Utah. Any person desiring to attend this event must show 
government-issued photo identification to be admitted past the building security 
station. Persons having questions they would like Enbridge Gas Utah (EGU) to address 
at the technical conference should email such questions on or before 5:00 p.m. on 
Tuesday, March 17, 2026, to the PSC (psc@utah.gov), Jenniffer Clark 
(jenniffer.clark@enbridge.com), and Austin Summers 
(austin.summers@enbridge.com). 
DOCKET NO. 26-057-03 

- 3 - 

The PSC gives notice that portions of the March 24, 2026 technical conference 
may be closed to preserve the confidentiality of sensitive information. Interested 
persons should contact EGU as soon as possible to discuss the possibility of executing 
a non-disclosure agreement with EGU to access the confidential portion of the 
technical conference. 

Individuals wishing to participate in the technical conference remotely should 
contact the PSC at least two days in advance by calling (801) 530-6716 or (toll-free) 
1-866-PSC-UTAH (1-866-772-8824) to receive connection information and 
instructions. 

Individuals needing accommodations during the conference should notify the 
PSC at 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, (801) 530-6716, at least three 
working days prior to the conference. 
NOTICE OF HEARING 

The PSC will conduct a hearing in this docket on Thursday, April 23, 2026, 
beginning at 9:00 a.m. The hearing will be held in the Fourth Floor Hearing Room 403, 
Heber M. Wells Building, 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah. All parties must 
have their witnesses in attendance and prepared to testify. Any person desiring to 
attend this event must show government-issued photo identification to be admitted 
past the building security station. 
DOCKET NO. 26-057-03 

- 4 - 

Individuals wishing to participate in the hearing remotely should contact the 
PSC at least two days in advance by calling (801) 530-6716 or (toll-free) 1-866-PSC-
UTAH (1-866-772-8824) to receive connection information and instructions. 

Individuals needing accommodations during the hearing should notify the PSC 
at 160 East 300 South, Salt Lake City, Utah 84111, (801) 530-6716, at least three 
working days prior to the hearing. 
DATED at Salt Lake City, Utah, March 9, 2026.
